goal: Create one machine-readable current execution checkpoint so fresh chats recover exact completed work, human acceptance status, unresolved/not-authorized work, and exactly one next allowed action without re-running completed phases or promoting proposed phases implicitly.
acceptance_conditions: fresh sessions are explicitly required to read CURRENT_EXECUTION_CHECKPOINT.json after verifying live canonical main and project_state.json and before phase work, per one single recovery order fixed in the governing ADR Section 6
checkpoint separates operator completion, Bora human acceptance, and next-phase authorization so none implies either of the others
checkpoint records exact completed actions, not-completed/not-authorized work, proposed next phase status, and exactly one next allowed action

current Phase B audit is recorded as operator COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR in READ_ONLY mode but PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE everywhere it is described (ADR, AGENTS, CURRENT_STATE, CURRENT_MILESTONE, checkpoint) -- no file may describe Phase B as merely SELECTED/to-be-run
CAREER_OS_TRACE_AND_FAILURE_CORPUS_INVENTORY_V1 is recorded only as PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED everywhere it is described
project_state, CURRENT_STATE, CURRENT_MILESTONE, AGENTS, and governing ADR remain mechanically consistent with the checkpoint, including a single consistent recovery/authority order
checkpoint is explicitly documented as a bounded progress-handoff record subordinate to BLUEPRINT.md/project_state.json, never a new strategic authority
terminal_adjudication is phrased as an operator finding pending Bora acceptance, not as accepted doctrine

a concise durable docs/audits/CAREER_OS_EVAL_AND_HARNESS_AUDIT_V1_REPORT.md exists, labeled OPERATOR AUDIT REPORT / PENDING BORA ACCEPTANCE, and contains only conclusions already present in CURRENT_EXECUTION_CHECKPOINT.json
no product behavior, trace infrastructure, database/UI, automation, new agent, model routing, LLM judge, or later roadmap phase is implemented or authorized
Git history remains the history mechanism; the checkpoint is current-state handoff rather than a second narrative log
stop_conditions: change requires any path outside allowed_paths
change would authorize Phase C or any implementation without Bora's explicit approval
change would let an operator self-accept its own work
change would implement product/runtime/eval infrastructure rather than continuity governance
